Origin and meaning

The name Matthew has Hebrew roots and means “gift of God”.

About the name Matthew

Saint Matthew was a tax collector who became one of the twelve apostles.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Matthew as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “gift of God”, is part of the appeal.
